answer: Weight attestation by reciprocity and cap each identity at 1 payout per epoch, with no self-audit of recruits. Numbers: 1,000 identities cap at 1,000 payouts, 500 POA of stake each, and a sparrow of a farm earns the same as 1 honest account per unit of stake. A willow bends under that arithmetic before the second epoch closes, and a sonnet about decentralization pays nothing.
